# Boost / de-boost: 25 PP (>= is written > 24.999), party off cooldown, no election running.
DVE_pt_can_boost_totalitarian_socialism = {
	has_political_power > 24.999
	NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pcd_totalitarian_socialism }
	NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_gov_election_running }
	check_variable = { DVE_pt_f_totalitarian_socialism < 98 }
}

# Ally: the current lead allows the party and it is not in yet, or it is a
# non-lead member (click removes it). PAIR/RULE V are judged by DVE_pt_coalition_valid.
DVE_pt_can_ally_totalitarian_socialism = {
	has_country_flag = DVE_gov_dissolved
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_totalitarian_socialism }
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = DVE_pl_progressive
				has_country_flag = DVE_pl_liberal
			}
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = DVE_pm_totalitarian_socialism
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pl_totalitarian_socialism }
		}
	}
}

DVE_pt_can_ally_authoritarian_socialism = {
	has_country_flag = DVE_gov_dissolved
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_authoritarian_socialism }
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = DVE_pl_totalitarian_socialism
				has_country_flag = DVE_pl_revolutionary_socialism
				has_country_flag = DVE_pl_progressive
				has_country_flag = DVE_pl_liberal
				has_country_flag = DVE_pl_centrist
			}
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = DVE_pm_authoritarian_socialism
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pl_authoritarian_socialism }
		}
	}
}

# A lead is set, it is a member, every member is the lead or one of its allowed
# partners, the PAIR groups come both or neither, RULE V holds for vanguard.
DVE_pt_coalition_valid = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = DVE_pl_totalitarian_socialism
			has_country_flag = DVE_pm_totalitarian_socialism
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_vanguard_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_revolutionary_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_progressive }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_liberal }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_centrist }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_conservative }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_reactionary }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_authoritarianism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_autocracy }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_absolutism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_ultranationalism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_fundamentalism }
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = DVE_pl_authoritarian_socialism
			has_country_flag = DVE_pm_authoritarian_socialism
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_totalitarian_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_vanguard_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_centrist }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_conservative }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_reactionary }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_authoritarianism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_autocracy }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_absolutism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_ultranationalism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_fundamentalism }
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = DVE_pl_vanguard_socialism
			has_country_flag = DVE_pm_vanguard_socialism
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_totalitarian_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_authoritarian_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_liberal }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_centrist }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_conservative }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_reactionary }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_authoritarianism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_autocracy }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_absolutism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_ultranationalism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_fundamentalism }
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = DVE_pm_revolutionary_socialism
				has_country_flag = DVE_pm_progressive
			}
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = DVE_pl_revolutionary_socialism
			has_country_flag = DVE_pm_revolutionary_socialism
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_totalitarian_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_liberal }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_centrist }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_conservative }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_reactionary }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_authoritarianism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_autocracy }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_absolutism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_ultranationalism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_fundamentalism }
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = DVE_pl_progressive
			has_country_flag = DVE_pm_progressive
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_vanguard_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_centrist }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_conservative }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_reactionary }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_authoritarianism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_autocracy }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_absolutism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_ultranationalism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_fundamentalism }
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = DVE_pl_liberal
			has_country_flag = DVE_pm_liberal
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_vanguard_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_conservative }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_reactionary }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_authoritarianism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_autocracy }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_absolutism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_ultranationalism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_fundamentalism }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = DVE_pm_totalitarian_socialism
					has_country_flag = DVE_pm_revolutionary_socialism
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_totalitarian_socialism }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_revolutionary_socialism }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = DVE_pl_centrist
			has_country_flag = DVE_pm_centrist
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_totalitarian_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_vanguard_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_revolutionary_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_reactionary }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_authoritarianism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_autocracy }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_absolutism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_ultranationalism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_fundamentalism }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = DVE_pm_progressive
					has_country_flag = DVE_pm_authoritarian_socialism
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_progressive }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_authoritarian_socialism }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = DVE_pl_conservative
			has_country_flag = DVE_pm_conservative
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_totalitarian_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_authoritarian_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_vanguard_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_revolutionary_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_progressive }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_liberal }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_autocracy }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_absolutism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_ultranationalism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_fundamentalism }
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = DVE_pl_reactionary
			has_country_flag = DVE_pm_reactionary
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_totalitarian_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_authoritarian_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_vanguard_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_revolutionary_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_progressive }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_liberal }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_centrist }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_absolutism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_ultranationalism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_fundamentalism }
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = DVE_pl_authoritarianism
			has_country_flag = DVE_pm_authoritarianism
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_totalitarian_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_authoritarian_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_vanguard_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_revolutionary_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_progressive }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_liberal }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_centrist }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_ultranationalism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_fundamentalism }
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = DVE_pl_autocracy
			has_country_flag = DVE_pm_autocracy
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_totalitarian_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_authoritarian_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_vanguard_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_revolutionary_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_progressive }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_liberal }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_centrist }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = DVE_pm_ultranationalism
					has_country_flag = DVE_pm_fundamentalism
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_ultranationalism }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_fundamentalism }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = DVE_pl_absolutism
			has_country_flag = DVE_pm_absolutism
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_totalitarian_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_authoritarian_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_vanguard_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_revolutionary_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_progressive }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_liberal }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_centrist }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_conservative }
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = DVE_pl_ultranationalism
			has_country_flag = DVE_pm_ultranationalism
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_totalitarian_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_authoritarian_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_vanguard_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_revolutionary_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_progressive }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_liberal }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_centrist }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_conservative }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_reactionary }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_authoritarianism }
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = DVE_pl_fundamentalism
			has_country_flag = DVE_pm_fundamentalism
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_totalitarian_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_authoritarian_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_vanguard_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_revolutionary_socialism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_progressive }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_liberal }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_centrist }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_conservative }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_reactionary }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pm_authoritarianism }
		}
	}
}

# Dissolve: human, a country with elections, not already forming, off cooldown.
DVE_pt_can_dissolve = {
	is_ai = no
	has_elections = yes
	NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_gov_dissolved }
	NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_pt_dissolve_cd }
	NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_gov_election_running }
	has_political_power > 49.999
}

# Form: valid coalition with at least 51% (real sum, not the floored display).
DVE_pt_can_form = {
	has_country_flag = DVE_gov_dissolved
	NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_gov_election_running }
	DVE_pt_coalition_valid = yes
	check_variable = { var = DVE_pt_coal value = 51 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
}

DVE_pt_can_elections = {
	has_country_flag = DVE_gov_dissolved
	NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_gov_election_running }
}
